title: Lighting Technicians
description: Set up, maintain, and dismantle light fixtures, lighting control devices, and the associated lighting electrical and rigging equipment used for photography, television, film, video, and live productions. May focus or operate light fixtures, or attach color filters or other lighting accessories.

tasks.text: Assess safety of wiring or equipment set-up to determine the risk of fire or electrical shock.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Hands-on safety inspection of physical equipment

dwas.name: Inspect equipment to ensure safety or proper functioning.

tasks.text: Consult with lighting director or production staff to determine lighting requirements.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Collaborative spec-setting requires human negotiation

dwas.name: Collaborate with others to determine design specifications or details.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Disassemble and store equipment after performances.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Disassembly requires hands-on tool use

dwas.name: Disassemble equipment for maintenance or repair.

tasks.text: Install color effects or image patterns, such as color filters, onto lighting fixtures.

dwas.name: Attach equipment extensions or accessories.

tasks.text: Install electrical cables or wire fixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical installation is hands-on licensed trade work

dwas.name: Install electrical components, equipment, or systems.

tasks.text: Load, unload, or position lighting equipment.

dwas.name: Load materials or equipment.
Unload materials or equipment.
Set up still or video cameras or related equipment.

tasks.text: Match light fixture settings, such as brightness and color, to lighting design plans.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical calibration to specifications

dwas.name: Calibrate equipment to specifications.

tasks.text: Notify supervisors when major lighting equipment repairs are needed.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Equipment problem notification is routine messaging

dwas.name: Notify others of equipment problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Operate manual or automated systems to control lighting throughout productions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Console operation requires live physical adjustment

dwas.name: Operate control consoles for sound, lighting or video.

tasks.text: Patch or wire lights to dimmers or other electronic consoles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Running wiring is hands-on installation

dwas.name: Run wiring to connect equipment.

tasks.text: Perform minor repairs or routine maintenance on lighting equipment, such as replacing lamps or damaged color filters.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical repair of electrical equipment

dwas.name: Repair electrical equipment.

tasks.text: Program lighting consoles or load automated lighting control systems onto consoles.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.
Install computer hardware.

tasks.text: Set up and focus light fixtures to meet requirements of television, theater, concerts, or other productions.

dwas.name: Set up still or video cameras or related equipment.

tasks.text: Set up scaffolding or cranes to assist with setting up of lighting equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on positioning of safety equipment in field

dwas.name: Position safety or support equipment.
Set up material handling gear or equipment, such as rigging, packaging, or temporary structures.

tasks.text: Test lighting equipment function and desired lighting effects.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI interprets results; human runs physical tests

dwas.name: Test performance of electrical, electronic, mechanical, or integrated systems or equipment.

tasks.text: Visit and assess structural and electrical layout of locations before setting up lighting equipment.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Work conditions require physical site assessment

dwas.name: Gather information about work conditions or locations.
